text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of a new, full-fledged training regimen to get Nice Nature ready to make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, I want to see how fast she is currently, so I ask some other Umamusume to run a scrimmage with Nice Nature. But then…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah. Heya, Trainer… can we talk for a second?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nothing is wrong exactly, but here's the deal…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm happy that you put together this scrimmage for me, and I reeeeally appreciate it. So much appreciation. But…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeeeees! I'm gonna run so fast today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! But if you think I'm gonna let you pass me, you've got another thing comin'!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What the heck is this lineup?! They're all top-level runners!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right—I only asked the best of the best. And it seems quite a few came, either out of curiosity or a sense of camaraderie.
choice_data_list: This lineup should be the perfect way to measure your strength!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: M-more like the perfect way to embarrass myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature starts off without confidence, but then…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant… Come ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look at Nature! She's keeping up with all those amazing runners!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Her results have always been solid. Seriously, Nature is a great runner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spectators are right, Nice Nature is in perfect form today!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I knew it—third place again.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well… Yeah, I guess so. With those runners, I'm proud of myself for even finishing in third place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But I was in the best position. I had the advantage in terms of distance, and I still got third…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature doesn't seem satisfied…

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nature! What a marvelous day for a race! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanna see your absolute best, Nature! Let's compete fair and square, like grown women should! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I put together another scrimmage. All the racers I invited seem to be acquainted with Nice Nature…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hold on here. Trainer, you just up and brought all your favorite racers, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I have to say… I like your taste. If I were you, I'd choose them too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm just joking. I know that they're all more than just cute faces. They're really fast on top of that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Natuuurrre! Come on, hurry up and run with meee! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um… Is that an angel? Maybe she can cleanse my soul while we're running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature jokes around, but once the race starts…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Nature is going so fast! She's keeping up with the other two!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Woohoo, another third place finish…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Those two are sooo young. I can't even begin to compete with that kind of energy.
choice_data_list: You aren't that much older than them.
You aren't that much older than them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. Even a one year gap can make a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, now you know, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: C'mon, what did I run those scrimmages for? You were sizing up my skills, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Close, but not quite." That's me in a nutshell.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I run okay, but "okay" isn't gonna win me the gold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …The way I see it, the fact that she finishes third no matter what shows that she's got potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's not how she sees it. I try to think of the best way to explain it to her, when…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey! Whatcha doing? Something fun?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Were you guys running a scrimmage? What a waste of time…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You guys didn't even invite the best racer around—me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio. As she says herself, she is the star runner in the current generation. Many were singing her praise even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means Tokai Teio will be an unavoidable wall between Nice Nature and glory.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She can say all that and not feel even a tinge of embarrassment. She's certainly something, I'll tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Did you say something? Whatever. Come on, get ready!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't just stand there! We're going head-to-head, Uma to Uma! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll give you the honor of a race!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …S-seriously?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, a battle between Nice Nature and Tokai Teio abruptly begins.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew… The sunset sure is beautiful today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Another day, another loss! What can I say? That Tokai Teio sure is strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The head-to-head with Tokai Teio ended in a clean defeat, with Nice Nature failing to catch up to Teio's pace.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Welp, I don't blame myself for losing to her! In fact, I did well, considering it was after I ran with Mayano and Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Yup, it always ends with "I did well." The idea of a third-rate runner like me shining in a race… might as well be a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Do you get it now, or do you still want to aim for victory with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to help make her dreams of shining like a star come true. As long as we're together, my feelings will never change.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking about this for a while now, but… where do you get all that confidence?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Your eyes are shining brighter than mine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Not sure if I can meet your expectations, but…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Maybe… it'd be okay for me to dream a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Nice Nature's journey to make her dreams come true begins!
